description: 影视镜头语言、运镜、光影与构图技法库

entries.title: 特写镜头
entries.content: 特写镜头 Close-up shot：聚焦人物面部或关键物体，突出情绪与细节。提示词：close-up shot, sharp focus on face, emotional expression, shallow depth of field, cinematic lighting, skin texture.

entries.title: 中景镜头
entries.content: 中景镜头 Medium shot：拍摄人物腰部以上，兼顾动作与表情。提示词：medium shot, waist-up framing, natural pose, clear body language, balanced composition.

entries.title: 广角 establishing shot
entries.content: 广角 establishing shot：展示环境与空间关系，奠定场景基调。提示词：wide establishing shot, grand environment, detailed background, atmospheric perspective, cinematic scale.

entries.title: 低角度仰拍
entries.content: 低角度仰拍 Low angle shot：镜头从下往上，强化主体威严、压迫感或英雄感。提示词：low angle shot, looking up at subject, powerful composition, dramatic sky background, imposing atmosphere.

entries.title: 荷兰角
entries.content: 荷兰角 Dutch angle：倾斜构图，制造不安、紧张或悬疑氛围。提示词：Dutch angle, tilted horizon, disorienting composition, tense mood, dramatic shadows.

entries.title: 过肩镜头
entries.content: 过肩镜头 Over-the-shoulder shot：从一人背后拍摄对话对象，增强对话代入感。提示词：over-the-shoulder shot, dialogue framing, shallow depth of field, natural conversation, cinematic.

entries.title: 跟随镜头
entries.content: 跟随镜头 Tracking shot：摄影机跟随主体移动，保持动态连贯。提示词：tracking shot, smooth camera follow, dynamic movement, consistent speed, cinematic motion.

entries.title: 推镜 Dolly in
entries.content: 推镜 Dolly in：摄影机缓慢前推，放大情绪张力。提示词：slow dolly in, gradual zoom, emotional intensity, shallow depth of field, cinematic.

entries.title: 手持镜头
entries.content: 手持镜头 Handheld shot：轻微晃动增强真实感与紧张感。提示词：handheld camera, subtle shake, documentary feel, gritty realism, immersive.

entries.title: 航拍镜头
entries.content: 航拍镜头 Aerial shot：从高空俯瞰，展现场景宏大与空间关系。提示词：aerial drone shot, bird's eye view, vast landscape, sweeping scale, cinematic establishing.

entries.title: 伦勃朗光
entries.content: 伦勃朗光 Rembrandt lighting：经典人像布光，面部三角形光斑，戏剧感强。提示词：Rembrandt lighting, dramatic portrait, triangle of light on cheek, deep shadows, cinematic mood.

entries.title: 黄金时刻光线
entries.content: 黄金时刻 Golden hour：日出日落前后的暖色柔和光线，浪漫温馨。提示词：golden hour lighting, warm soft sunlight, long shadows, dreamy atmosphere, orange glow.

entries.title: 霓虹灯光
entries.content: 霓虹灯光 Neon lighting：霓虹灯管发出的高饱和色彩，营造都市夜景或赛博氛围。提示词：neon lighting, vibrant colored lights, reflections on wet pavement, cyberpunk mood, high contrast.

entries.title: 逆光剪影
entries.content: 逆光剪影 Backlight silhouette：主体背对强光源，形成轮廓光或剪影。提示词：backlit silhouette, rim light, strong backlight, dramatic outline, misty atmosphere.

entries.title: 青橙色调
entries.content: 青橙色调 Teal and orange：经典电影调色，肤色偏橙、阴影偏青，对比强烈。提示词：teal and orange color grading, cinematic color palette, high contrast, film look, professional grading.

entries.title: 低饱和色调
entries.content: 低饱和色调 Desaturated：降低色彩饱和度，营造压抑、纪实或末日氛围。提示词：desaturated color grading, muted tones, grim atmosphere, documentary style, realistic.

entries.title: 面部/眼睛 extreme close-up
entries.content: extreme close-up shot: focus on eyes or facial micro-expressions, shallow depth of field, intimate, dramatic

entries.title: 全身 full body shot
entries.content: full body shot: show entire figure and posture, clean framing, head to toe, fashion or action context

entries.title: 双人镜头 two-shot
entries.content: two-shot: frame two subjects together, suitable for dialogue or emotional interaction, balanced composition

entries.title: 群像 group shot
entries.content: group shot: multiple subjects arranged in layers, ensemble composition, clear spatial relations

entries.title: 第一人称视角 POV shot
entries.content: POV shot: first-person perspective, immersive, hands or foreground props visible, subjective camera

entries.title: 移焦 rack focus
entries.content: rack focus: shift focus from foreground to background or vice versa, dramatic attention transition

entries.title: 快速摇镜 whip pan
entries.content: whip pan: fast horizontal camera pan, motion blur, energetic transition, dynamic

entries.title: 变焦推近 zoom in
entries.content: zoom in: lens focal length gradually tightens, dramatic emphasis, increasing tension

entries.title: 升降镜头 crane shot
entries.content: crane shot: camera rises or descends on a crane, sweeping vertical movement, grand scale

entries.title: 斯坦尼康稳定镜头 steadicam smooth glide
entries.content: steadicam shot: smooth floating camera movement, seamless glide through space, professional cinematic motion

entries.title: 固定长镜头 static long take
entries.content: static long take: fixed camera position, sustained observation, theatrical staging, minimalist

entries.title: 分屏 split screen
entries.content: split screen: multiple frames shown simultaneously, parallel narrative, graphic layout

entries.title: 匹配剪辑 match cut transition
entries.content: match cut: seamless transition between two visually similar shots, graphic match, continuity

entries.title: 微距 macro shot
entries.content: macro shot: extreme magnification of small details, shallow depth of field, texture rich

entries.title: 慢动作 slow motion
entries.content: slow motion: high frame rate playback, stretched time, dramatic emphasis on movement and detail

entries.title: 延时摄影 time-lapse / hyperlapse
entries.content: time-lapse / hyperlapse: compressed time, clouds or crowds streaking, dynamic spatial movement

entries.title: 柔光箱 softbox lighting
entries.content: softbox lighting: large, soft, even light source, gentle shadows, studio portrait or interview look

entries.title: 烛光 candlelight
entries.content: candlelight: warm flickering light, soft orange glow, intimate period atmosphere, gentle shadows

entries.title: 月光 moonlight
entries.content: moonlight: cool blue-silver night illumination, soft shadows, romantic or mysterious mood

entries.title: 暖色辉光 warm glow
entries.content: warm glow: golden-orange highlights, hazy softness, cozy and nostalgic atmosphere

entries.title: 高调 high-key lighting
entries.content: high-key lighting: bright, low contrast, minimal shadows, cheerful and clean look

entries.title: 单色 monochrome
entries.content: monochrome: single color family or black and white, strong tonal contrast, timeless aesthetic

entries.title: 三分法 rule of thirds
entries.content: rule of thirds: place subject at intersection lines, balanced and visually pleasing composition

entries.title: 对称构图 symmetrical composition
entries.content: symmetrical composition: mirror-like balance, centered subject, formal and grand aesthetic

entries.title: 雨天 rain atmosphere
entries.content: rain atmosphere: visible rain streaks, wet reflective surfaces, moody cinematic environment

entries.title: 雪天 snow atmosphere
entries.content: snow atmosphere: falling snowflakes, soft white blanket, cold muted tones, serene or melancholic

entries.title: 雾气 fog/mist atmosphere
entries.content: fog/mist atmosphere: hazy visibility, soft diffused light, mysterious depth layers
